title: Goals of the lab
lede: Any persisting collection of agents that interact with each other and feedback on their environment face the same problem: how to cope with fluctuations while maintaining long-term integrity. This is true whether the collection of agents refers to stem cells undergoing differentiation during development, species coexisting in an ecosystem, or traders maximizing profit in future markets. I call these ecologies. I try to escape the curse of reification, and value substance over form. This lab focuses on:

goals.label: Snapshot attractor
goals.legend: Snapshot attractor of a seasonally forced predator and prey (Rosenzweig-MacArthur, ε = 0.8, period 10): 500 populations driven by the same seasons forget where they started and gather on one chaotic set that keeps changing shape.

scene.system:
x' = x*(1 + eps*sin(2*pi*t/T))*(1 - x) - a*x*y/(b + x)
y' = y*(a*x/(b + x) - d)
param a = 1
param b = 0.3
param d = 0.35
param eps = 0.8
param T = 10
init x = 0.5
init y = 0.3
range x = [0, 1]
range y = [0, 0.8]

goals.name: Transiency
goals.text: How systems avoid vanishing away while flowing in a permanently transient state.

goals.label: Quasiperiodic torus
goals.legend: Predator and prey under weak seasonal forcing (ε = 0.1) with a period of 32.7, 1.62 times the natural cycle of 20.2: orbits wind on an invariant torus, quasiperiodic with rotation number 0.607.

scene.system:
x' = x*(1 + eps*u)*(1 - x) - a*x*y/(b + x)
y' = y*(a*x/(b + x) - d)
u' = w*v
v' = -w*u
param a = 1
param b = 0.3
param d = 0.35
param eps = 0.1
param w = 0.19214
init x = 0.5
init y = 0.3
init u = 0
init v = 1

goals.name: Feedback loops
goals.text: How interactions between agents and their environment shape persistence.

goals.label: Return after pulses
goals.legend: Predator and prey below the Hopf point (K = 3 < 3.75): every 120 time units a pulse removes 70 percent of the prey, and the ensemble spirals back to coexistence, its displacement shrinking by a factor e every 40 time units (eigenvalues −0.025 ± 0.435i).

scene.system:
N' = r*N*(1 - N/K) - a*N*P/(1 + a*h*N)
P' = e*a*N*P/(1 + a*h*N) - m*P
param r = 1
param K = 3
param a = 1
param h = 0.4
param e = 0.6
param m = 0.3
init N = 0.625
init P = 0.99
range N = [0, 3]
range P = [0, 1.6]

goals.name: Robustness
goals.text: The ability of systems to maintain integrity amidst fluctuations.
